```{r}
# reading in the dataset
ds = read.csv("capstone_data.csv")
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# overview of the data
dim(ds)

summary(ds)
```

```{r}
# duplication check
anyDuplicated(ds)
```
```{r}
# missingness check
missing_summary <- ds %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), 
               names_to = "column", 
               values_to = "missing_count") %>%
  mutate(missing_pct = round(missing_count / nrow(ds) * 100, 2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_pct))

print(missing_summary, n = 65)
```
